emptyFinishedTitle: Finished recordings will show up here
emptyDescription: Record from a live room; its task appears here.
namingDescription: Date, time, platform, room id and title placeholders are available.
namingDialogHint: Enter the naming template for recording files
maxSizeDescription: Ends the take once it reaches the cap; measured in MB.
deleteBody: This removes the task only; files already saved stay on disk.
segmentDescription: How long each segment runs; finished segments stay playable after a crash.
readTimeoutDescription: How long a silent live input is waited for before the read fails.
queueDescription: The FFmpeg input packet queue; a larger one absorbs live bursts.
preferBestDescription: Map only the first video and audio streams, so a multi-bitrate source does not become a multi-track file.
keepAliveDescription: Hold a background session and wake lock while recording (Android foreground service and notification).
verifyDescription: Check the segments are playable before the session ends.
restartDescription: How often FFmpeg reopens a broken stream; 0 disables retries.
backoffDescription: The wait between two reopen attempts.
stallDescription: How long without new data counts as a stalled stream and reopens it.
watermarkDescription: Stop recording when free space falls below this.
maxTasksDescription: New recording requests are refused once this many run.
containerDescription: TS survives interruptions best; MP4 opens in ordinary players.
recordChatDescription: Save live chat beside each video in the formats chosen under Danmaku → Danmaku files; needs a platform with remote chat
defaultQualityDesc: Ask the platform for this quality when a recording starts; when it is unavailable, the current playback line is used.
enablePollingDesc: Automatically poll while the streamer is offline; add a room with “Record when live” in the room’s more menu.
pollingOff: Live check is off; waiting tasks will not start automatically.
cacheLimitEnabledDesc: Delete the oldest finished takes when the cap is exceeded; active recordings are never deleted.
cacheLimitDesc: Measured in MB; above it the oldest takes are deleted, never an active recording.
cacheSizeDesc: Total bytes of finished and active files in the managed folder.
cacheClearDesc: Delete every finished take and its danmaku XML; active recordings stay.
cacheClearConfirmDesc: This deletes finished videos, segments and danmaku files in the managed folder and cannot be undone; active recordings are skipped.
cacheManagedHint: To protect other files, a chosen directory gets an app-owned PureLiveRecords child folder.
liveCheckSecondsDesc: How often each waiting task checks its room, 10–300 seconds.
checkBackoffDesc: Stretch the interval after repeated failures so the platform is not polled too often.
maxCheckSecondsDesc: The ceiling the stretched interval approaches, 60–3600 seconds.
autoStartOnBootDesc: Turn tasks still marked recording after an interrupted process into waiting tasks for the live check; stopped and finished tasks keep their state.
cacheBusy: A recording is in progress (possibly in another window); the cache will not be cleared or trimmed now.
